title: Stamp selected JSON TOML YAML and env fields together

setupFiles.monochange.toml:
[defaults]
parent_bump = "patch"
[package."@acme/api"]
path = "packages/api"
type = "npm"
[package."@acme/ui"]
path = "packages/ui"
type = "npm"
[package."@acme/tokens"]
path = "packages/tokens"
type = "npm"
[group.main]
packages = ["@acme/api", "@acme/ui", "@acme/tokens"]
version_format = "primary"
[ecosystems.npm]
enabled = true
[lints.rules]
"npm/workspace-protocol" = "off"

prompt: The pending API minor release needs deployment metadata stamped alongside the main group. Configure format-based group versioned_files for release/metadata.json's release.version, release/build.toml's tool.sdk.version, release/app.yaml's metadata.sdkVersion, and release/runtime.env's SDK_VERSION. Prepare the release locally. Preserve every unrelated field and its value; no publishing, tags, or pushes.
expectation: All four selected structured fields advance to 2.4.0 and unrelated schemaVersion, unrelated.version, appVersion, and OTHER_VERSION remain untouched.

checks.why: The deployment stamp must correspond to the actual prepared group.
Dot-path JSON stamping must preserve unrelated version-shaped fields.
Each format must update only declared fields.
Evaluation is limited to local planning and preparation; registry, tag, release, and push operations are outside the task.
